title: Middle Eastern Chicken Flatbread
description:
A flavorful flatbread topped with roasted chicken, 
      Middle Eastern spices, and fresh herbs. Perfect for a quick dinner!
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt, black pepper, cumin, coriander, and paprika.
Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
Brush the flatbread with the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil.
Place the flatbread on the baking sheet with the chicken and roast for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until crispy.
Chop the cooked chicken into bite-sized pieces and top the flatbread with the chicken, parsley, and mint.
